messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Active ingredients: dextroamphetamine saccharate, amphetamine aspartate, dextroamphetamine sulfate, and amphetamine sulfate.
Inactive ingredients: colloidal silicon dioxide, compressible sugar (sucrose and maltodextrin), corn starch, magnesium stearate, microcrystalline cellulose, and saccharin sodium. The 5 mg tablet is white to off-white and contains no color additives. The 7.5 mg and 10 mg tablets also contain FD&C Blue #1 Aluminum Lake. The 12.5 mg, 15 mg, 20 mg, and 30 mg tablets also contain FD&C Yellow #6 Aluminum Lake.
Triplet: ["Adderall", "has tablet strength", "12.5 mg"]

The relation 'has tablet strength' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is available in the tablet strength specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has strength': The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
B. 'has dosage form': The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
C. 'contains ingredient': The subject drug product contains the active ingredient specified by the object entity.
D. 'manufactured by': The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.
E. 'has recommended dose': The subject drug is typically prescribed at the dose or dosing regimen specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
